description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the PerformanceTrackerDao class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes setup procedures, mocks for testing exception handling, and specific unit tests for methods like savePerformanceTracker, isTrackerReviewer, and updatePerformanceTracker.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceTrackerDao data access object in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test data before each test execution.

methods.name: testSavePerformanceTrackerWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests that savePerformanceTracker throws a TransactionException when the persist method throws a general Exception.

methods.name: testIsTrackerReviewerWithNullEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies that isTrackerReviewer returns false if the employee number provided is null.

methods.name: testUpdatePerformanceTrackerWithEmptyReviewerArray
methods.description: Checks that updatePerformanceTracker returns the original PerformanceTracker entity unchanged when given an empty reviewer array.
